abundance.description: Sense of plenty, resources, receiving, flow of support.

asset_acquisition.description: Buying/accumulating assets (property, vehicles, land, durable wealth).

adaptability.description: Flexibility, ability to adjust, learn, and pivot under change.

ambition.description: Drive to achieve goals, status, growth, competition.

anxiety.description: Worry, nervousness, anticipatory stress, insecurity about outcomes.

assertiveness.description: Directness, initiative, willingness to confront or act.

authority.description: Formal power, command, seniority, ability to enforce decisions.

bonding.description: Attachment, commitment, emotional joining, partnership glue.

burnout_risk.description: Risk of exhaustion due to sustained effort, pressure, or depletion.

business_growth.description: Business expansion, scaling, revenue growth, entrepreneurship momentum.

cashflow.description: Liquidity, monthly inflow/outflow balance, ability to pay near-term expenses.

career_momentum.description: Forward movement in career, promotions, traction, visibility of progress.

career_change.description: Switching roles/industries; transitions and readiness to pivot career direction.

children_fertility.description: Fertility, conception potential, desire/ability to have children.

childcare_responsibility.description: Parenting load, childcare duties, responsibility toward kids.

confidence.description: Self-belief, courage, internal certainty, feeling capable.

creativity.description: Imagination, artistic output, novel ideas, creative expression.

court_case_risk.description: Risk of litigation, legal disputes, court involvement.

constraints.description: Blockages, restrictions, lack of freedom, delays or obstacles.

debt_pressure.description: Debt load and repayment stress; loans, EMIs, obligations.

decision_clarity.description: Clarity, discernment, ability to choose without confusion.

discipline.description: Consistency, structure, routines, patience, delayed gratification.

domestic_harmony.description: Peace and functioning at home; family comfort and household stability.

education_success.description: Academic performance, exam success, learning outcomes.

emotional_healing.description: Recovery, integration, closure, regaining balance after pain.

emotional_burden.description: Heaviness, sadness, emotional load or duty affecting mood.

emotional_restraint.description: Containment of emotions, guarded expression, composure.

emotional_security.description: Feeling safe, supported, steady; low fear of abandonment or loss.

empathy.description: Understanding others' feelings; compassion and care.

execution_drive.description: Ability and momentum to execute tasks, push through obstacles.

existential_questioning.description: Tendency to question meaning, purpose, belief systems.

family_alignment.description: Fit with family expectations and long-term domestic alignment.

financial_growth.description: Capacity for income increase, wealth compounding, scalable upside.

financial_pressure.description: Money stress, obligations, cashflow strain, debt/expense load.

foreign_settlement.description: Longer-term settling abroad: immigration, residency, living overseas.

forgiveness.description: Letting go of resentment, ability to reconcile or soften blame.

fragmentation_risk.description: Scattered focus, instability, conflicting pulls or disintegration.

freedom.description: Autonomy, room to maneuver, independence from constraints.

health_risk.description: Likelihood of health issues, vulnerability, disease/accident risk.

home_property.description: Property, home ownership, land/real-estate matters and stability.

harmony.description: Ease, peace, cooperation, lack of friction in relationships.

integrity.description: Honesty, moral consistency, alignment between words and actions.

inner_restlessness.description: Internal agitation, anxiety, unsettled mind or emotional churn.

intimacy.description: Emotional closeness, vulnerability, affection, mutual openness.

investment_gain.description: Returns from investments, market gains, portfolio growth.

job_security.description: Stability and continuity of employment; low risk of job loss.

loan_approval.description: Ability to secure loans/credit; approvals for financing.

leadership.description: Taking charge, responsibility for others, influence and direction.

learning.description: Skill acquisition, curiosity, study, training and improvement.

luck.description: Favorable timing, supportive coincidences, ease of opportunity.

miscommunication_risk.description: Likelihood of misunderstanding, mixed signals, and communication breakdown.

money_management.description: Budgeting, saving, risk control, financial discipline and planning.

negotiation.description: Ability to bargain, resolve terms, and reach favorable agreements.

meaning_drive.description: Need for purpose, significance, narrative coherence.

networking.description: Ability to build connections, leverage contacts, social capital.

pattern_recognition.description: Seeing connections, abstractions, systems, symbolic relationships.

public_reputation.description: Standing in community/work, recognition, credibility, name value.

property_dispute.description: Conflicts about land/property, inheritance, boundaries, ownership disputes.

recovery_capacity.description: Ability to bounce back after setbacks; resilience and re-stabilization.

relationship_repair.description: Capacity to fix, renegotiate, and improve a relationship after conflict.

philosophy.description: Interest in principles, ethics, belief, wisdom and worldview.

pressure.description: External constraints, load, deadlines, stress from obligation.

prosperity_potential.description: Ceiling of wealth outcomes (e.g., millionaire/billionaire scale), scaling leverage.

risk_tolerance.description: Willingness to take calculated risks; comfort with uncertainty for upside.

relocation.description: Moving homes/cities; major location change, resettlement.

relationship_orientation.description: Prioritization of relationship needs, partnership seeking.

relationship_stability.description: Durability of partnership; low volatility, fewer break/return cycles.

restlessness.description: Urgency, impatience, desire for change or stimulation.

romance.description: Love, affection, warmth, sweetness; romantic tone and enjoyment.

sensitivity.description: Emotional receptivity, empathy, strong affective response.

support_system.description: Presence of helpful allies: friends, mentors, family backing, community.

spiritual_growth.description: Spiritual development, devotion, inner practice, faith deepening.

stability.description: Consistency, predictability, steadiness and durability over time.

status.description: Rank, prestige, social standing, respect and recognition.

symbolic_thinking.description: Use of symbols, metaphors, archetypes to reason or interpret.

trust.description: Reliability, faith in partner/others, belief that intentions are good.

trust_breach_risk.description: Risk of betrayal, cheating, secrecy, broken promises, hidden actions.

vehicle_purchase.description: Buying vehicles and related big-ticket mobility assets.

visibility.description: Being seen: discoverability, spotlight, attention in work or society.
